profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: A developer with more than eight years of experience in .NET. Experienced with working in collaborative team environments, within varied roles, in a range of projects. Excellent communication skills and strong background working directly with project clients to identify business objectives and establish requirements.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.insights: User Requirements, Interpersonal Skills and +1 skill

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained multi-tenant Content Management System (CMS) solutions.
• Led requirement discovery, design, and development of custom, user-friendly, accessibility-compliant, responsive (mobile-friendly) controls.
• Formalized, built upon, and managed existing processes for streamlining deployment to development, staging, and production servers. 
• Led deployment of bug fixes or feature requests for multiple clients.
• Managed multiple client accounts. Interfaced directly with client managers and executives for requirements gathering and documentation.

Primary Technologies: ASP.NET, C#/VB.NET, JavaScript, HTML, CSS (LESS and SASS), T-SQL, Subversion (TortoiseSVN), TFS, Visual Studio (2013, 2015, 2017)
Secondary Technologies: Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator
positions.insights: User Requirements, Interpersonal Skills and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Languages: C#, ReactJS, JavaScript (TypeScript w/ TSLint), T-SQL
Frameworks: ASP.NET Core 2.0 (WebAPI)
Version control: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio Team Services (VSTS), Git
IDE: VS2019, VS2017, VS Code, Sql Server Management Studio (SSMS) v14
positions.insights: User Requirements, Interpersonal Skills and +1 skill

positions.title: Sr. Analyst - Solutions Developer (Application Development)
positions.description:
Airlines Integrated Solutions Provider – Front-end Web Developer
• Led the development of one key user control (Price Breakdown tool), which interacted with the other controls and persisted across multiple pages 
• Developed five separate web page UI controls used to create airline bookings
• Managed the triage and front-end development of six web parts
Relevant Tech: ASP.NET MVC 4, Twitter Bootstrap, Knockout

Natural Resource Company (mineral, oil, and gas) – On-shore C# Developer/Junior Lead
• Served as bridge between project manager and offshore team; ensured business data requirements were being met by prioritizing client requests 
• Implemented domain models for offshore team
Relevant Tech: ASP.NET MVC 4

Arizona-based Medical Systems Company – Software Design Documentation Coordinator
• Primarily responsible for coordinating the Technical Assessment (and eventual release) of the Software Design Documentation.
• Ensured error-handling requirements were kept up-to-date and regulation-compliant in ALM.
Relevant Tech: HPQC/ALM

California-based Healthcare Provider – Report Developer
• Work with BA team to gather requirements and develop business-critical reports
• Handle requests for creating brand new reports, as well as converting old reports to be used in new MS-CRM environment
Relevant Tech: T-SQL, SSRS

Real Estate Company – SharePoint Front-end Developer
• Brought onto project to achieve delivery deadlines
Relevant Tech: ASP.NET Web Forms, Telerik UI Web Controls

Global Financial Services - Report Developer
• Organized and managed stored procedure and report migrations to the BETA and Production servers
• Performed daily validations (proof sheets) to verify proper data migration
• Completed Report defect/enhancement requests
• Developed 20 business-critical financial and statistical reports linked to MS CRM
Relevant Tech: PL/SQL, SSRS, Business Intelligence Development Studio (BIDS)
positions.insights: User Requirements, Interpersonal Skills and +1 skill

positions.title: Email Analyst Student Lead
positions.description:
•	Contribute to the processing of incoming email requests to ensure that these requests are routed to the proper work groups in a timely manner. 
•	Have a broad knowledge of the UW IT Service Center operations, the University of Washington, as well as UW Technology IT Consulting and Support groups. 
•	Responsible for assisting other student staff with questions they may have about UW IT’s policies and procedures.

positions.title: Student Consultant/Technical Support
positions.description:
Interact with faculty/staff and students on the phone, and through infomail system, to:
•	Facilitate timely, quality responses for account management questions. 
•	Support connectivity software from the UW Internet Connectivity Kit. 
•	Configure mail clients and software for XP/Vista/7, Mac OS 10+, and UNIX.
